title: W39231B 12 Digit GT Basic Calculator
body_html: Deli W39231B is a 12-digit desktop calculator with grand total (GT), step check and correct, solar and battery dual power and a 3-year warranty.

details.description: Deli W39231B is a 12-digit desktop calculator with grand total (GT), step check and correct, solar and battery dual power and a 3-year warranty.
details.usageInstructions: Press ON/AC to switch on, enter the numbers and operators, then press = for the result. Use the solar panel in good light or replace the battery when the display fades.
details.dangerWarnings: Do not drop, wet or press hard on the keys. Keep away from small children. Replace the battery only with the same type.
